description: The literal census of each unit (CENSO-NO-MANIFESTO; D-063, D-064 a, D-067): where a unit keeps its append-only census record, how the record is sealed, and the per-area files it replaces, which are now a derived view.

census.baseline_legacy_dir.description: The directory of the old per-area baseline files (one <area>.json each, D-064 a). The readers merge them with the unit records until scripts/census migrate has emptied them, and refuse an area file the base does not have, so once the migration deletes them none comes back. scripts/generate census renders the derived view at the same paths.

census.baseline_view_description.default: Derived on demand by `scripts/generate census` from the units' census records (units/<id>/census.jsonl); never committed and never edited. One census area's remaining offenders (D-063, D-064 a), per file and value. `scripts/census sync --why <why>` brings the records up to date with the scan; scripts/structure-check fails when an area allows a value more times than the base branch.
census.baseline_view_description.description: The description at the top of each rendered per-area baseline file.

census.catalog_legacy_dir.description: The directory of the old per-area catalog files (one <area>.json each, D-064 a). The readers merge them with the unit records until scripts/census migrate has emptied them, and refuse an area file the base does not have, so once the migration deletes them none comes back. scripts/generate census renders the derived view at the same paths.

census.catalog_view_description.default: Derived on demand by `scripts/generate census` from the units' census records (units/<id>/census.jsonl); never committed and never edited. The literal catalogs of one census area (D-063): every file whose literals are the documented keys of a domain. Write an entry with `scripts/census add <path> --catalog --domain <d> --holds <text> --why <why>`.
census.catalog_view_description.description: The description at the top of each rendered per-area catalog file.

census.digest_algorithm.description: Hash of a census event. Each event carries the digest of the one before it, so an edited, reordered or removed event breaks the chain (scripts/lib/audit_chain.py).

census.genesis_digest.description: The 'previous digest' of the first event of every census record.

census.record_file.description: File name, inside units/<id>/, of the unit's census record: one sealed event per line, written only by scripts/census.

census.scan_argv.description: The absolute scan that scripts/census add and sync read baseline counts from, run from the repository root. It prints one `path:line: kind "value" (role)` line per offender. A person never types a count. Empty (the default): the scan is the engine's own literal census (literal_census.occurrences over config.literal_check_*, judged by literals.*), so add and sync work in the engine; a product declares its own scanner here (OU-DECOUPLE F5, D-113: the only declared scanner was the deleted product's).

census.scan_timeout.description: The longest the absolute scan may run before scripts/census stops it.

census.schema.description: The contract every event of a census record validates against.
